focus.rule: Never obscure, clip, or animate away keyboard focus.

provenance.qualitativeLanguage: Sift's design direction notes and product brief; no interview requested.
provenance.tonalRamps: Not synthesized: no source ramps exist and the brief prohibits invented values.
provenance.limitations: Harbor palette captures were built and reviewed in both themes and desktop/mobile; shared motion behavior is documented, not newly certified by this palette-only capture.

motionRules.travel: Shared springs for every spatial change, including departure.
motionRules.fade: Independent short opacity/color durations; leave easing for departures.
motionRules.history: Historical Sift CSS ledger remains provenance, not the new travel recipe.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Canonical token roles; keyboard focus remains visible.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md); font: 500 14px/1.5 var(--font-body); padding: 8px 14px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--hover); color: var(--ink); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Quiet action
components.description: Canonical token roles; keyboard focus remains visible.
components.css: .ds-button-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md); font: 500 14px/1.5 var(--font-body); padding: 8px 14px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-ghost:hover { background: var(--hover); color: var(--ink); } .ds-button-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Labeled field
components.description: Keep a visible label and a control boundary.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Task name<input class="ds-input" value="Calibrate soil-moisture probe" /></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink); font: 550 13px/1.5 var(--font-body); } .ds-input { background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--control-line); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 8px 10px; font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-body); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter chip
components.description: Canonical token roles; keyboard focus remains visible.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: var(--tint); color: var(--ink); border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); height: 28px; padding: 0 11px 0 10px; font: 400 12.5px/1.5 var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--hover); color: var(--ink); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Selected destination
components.description: Use rail-specific foreground and focus roles.
components.css: .ds-nav { background: var(--rail); padding: 12px; } .ds-nav-selected { display: block; background: var(--rail-selected); color: var(--rail-selected-foreground); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 10px 12px; font: 400 13px/1.5 var(--font-body); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-selected:hover { background: var(--rail-hover); color: var(--rail-foreground); } .ds-nav-selected:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--rail-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Task card
components.description: Canonical token roles; keyboard focus remains visible.
components.css: .ds-task-card { text-align: left; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 16px 14px 14px; font: 400 14px/1.65 var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; } .ds-task-card:hover { background: var(--hover); color: var(--ink); } .ds-task-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Build a precise studio workbench: navigational rails, orderly work surfaces, pinned context, and visible handoffs. Use Operate mode: help a person find, inspect, and change real work; do not turn the workspace into a presentation.

Keep the shell stable while the work changes. Use springs for spatial travel and scale, short durations for fades, direct manipulation, velocity-preserving interruption, and continuity of shared elements. Show actual local state, attribute helper actions, and preserve the person’s reading position and drafts. Use restrained density, deliberate typography, and interruptible motion rather than dashboard tiles or chat-first composition.
keyCharacteristics: Both themes are authored; dark is layered charcoal.
One accent, legible hairlines, flat work surfaces.
Motion explains state and preserves orientation.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Use --accent for links, selection, and focus. Reserve status and categorical colors for meaning; do not add a competing interface accent.

rules.name: The Flat Work Rule
rules.body: Keep cards and work surfaces flat. Apply --shadow-float only to layers above the work; do not use a hover lift as routine decoration.

dos: Do use token roles and test both themes.
Do keep the shell fixed during route changes and use direction-aware work-surface motion.
Do attribute helper changes and expose the reason and available undo.
Do use Albert Sans at 14px for task text and IBM Plex Mono for dense counts, times, durations, IDs, and keys.
Do use 6px, 8px, and 12px core radii and reserve shadows for floating layers.
donts: Don’t copy stale Geist, blue-accent, or plum-dark guidance from earlier revisions.
Don’t invent counters, progress, completion evidence, or artificial waits.
Don’t use decoration gradients, glassmorphism, emoji, stock metric tiles, or pale-on-pale controls.
Don’t animate the shell on navigation, replay arrivals for existing items, or animate streamed tokens.
Don’t convey status or chart identity with color alone.
